m: Rinse the quinoa and simmer in 2 parts water for 12 minutes. Drain, then stir through chopped parsley, lemon zest and halved tomatoes.
Season the fish generously with cracked pepper, lemon zest and salt.
Pan-fry in a little oil over medium-high heat, 2 to 3 minutes a side, until opaque and flaking.
Same pan: the broccoli and beans with a splash of water for 3 minutes, then the garlic and spinach until wilted.
Squeeze lemon over everything and serve the fish on the quinoa with the greens.
l: Fish over quinoa and greens. Eat within a day.
